# Project Agent Rules (oversize render fixture)

A token-free template deliberately larger than Codex's 32768-byte
AGENTS.md default cap (project_doc_max_bytes): the canonical renderer
passes it through, and render-agents-md.sh must exit 1 with the
dual-delivery instruction. Filler paragraphs below are neutral prose
with no Claude-lane constructs.

Filler paragraph 0001: keep the working tree clean, capture test
output to a file outside the repo, verify each destructive operation
after it runs, and prefer the smallest tool that does the whole job.
